payload.title: File:Liopleurodon Size.svg
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of Liopleurodon ferox based on the specimen CAMSM J.27424. Note that while large, this specimen is estimated to be slightly smaller than the more complete NHMUK R3536. The head was drawn following Noè's skull diagram, the postcranium was drawn following the mounted specimen GPIT-RE-3184, and the tail was restored based on Peloneustes. The diver silhoutte was modified from File:Scuba33.jpg, which is by NOAA, and in the public domain.

  • Noè, L. F. (2001) A taxonomic and functional study of the Callovian (Middle Jurassic) Pliosauroidea (Reptilia, Sauropterygia) (Thesis), Chicago: University of Derby
